title: Skydude221's Music Discs
description: Adds 15 original craftable tracks + several stereo versions
body:
This project adds 25 original music discs (15 mono + 9 3D split tracks + 1 blank disc used only for crafting) written by me to Minecraft. Each music disc is fully obtainable in survival mode via crafting (they will not generate in structures, but that may change in future versions!).

![A creative mode tab displaying several new and colorful music discs, titled "Skydude's Music Discs".](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/43823911a1ae7eb35d1fbd8da54623c54d775d87.png)

Most of the music discs can be crafted with any vanilla music disc + some material(s), with the exception of **Fjords** and **Slipstream**, which must be crafted using their constituent discs.

### Fjords
The two halves will play a different version of the song meant for the left and right ears respectively, that give the effect of a 3D sound when played together.

![A shapeless crafting recipe two halves of a blue and green music disc with a white outline resulting in a whole music disc](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f6857dc2b264a2916865d7c694e9320096a9e495.png)

### Slipstream
The discs numbered 1-7 correspond to 7 individual instruments of the track that, when played together in sync, create a 3D sound.

![A shapeless crafting recipe of red music discs with yellow centers numbered 1 to 7 resulting in a single red music disc with a yellow center](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6c8eeac53f24800fd72796540cf944a6e1c716e5.png)

### Blank Music Disc (used in renewable crafting recipes)
![A shaped crafting recipe showing 8 coal around a resin brick, yielding one blank music disc. Charcoal also works.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a8c324d47d91f283153481a3ea684e0e312b6594.png)

Make sure you have the latest version of NeoForge installed before running this mod!
